confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on several aggregated price sites that disagree, mainly at the low end; the midrange meal is set above the crowd-sourced $14 figures because those look too low for three courses for two. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly supported and follow the beer relationship (cocktail about 3.3x beer) and sparse menu data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. CZK figures were converted at an approximate 21.5 CZK per USD derived from aggregator conversions, not a verified FX source. FX: the 0.6720 observation for 2026-11-18 came from a third-party summary attributed to the RBA; an RBA page read returned only older March 2026 data, so the value is not verified on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is a mid-sized Czech city priced below Prague. Food and drink anchors use Brno-specific listings and aggregator estimates, cross-checked against Prague as an upper reference. Accommodation anchors use general knowledge of Czech regional hostel and hotel pricing for a July window, with no comparable-city lookup.
